high_level_description: The image is a fashion photograph featuring a model posing dynamically against a plain white background. The model is wearing a stylish, layered skirt that has a mix of textures and colors. The skirt is predominantly beige with green and gold metallic accents, giving it a luxurious and modern look. The top part of the skirt appears to be made of a pleated fabric, while the lower part features ruffled, metallic gold and green layers. The model is also wearing a sleeveless top with a black and white striped pattern on the sides, paired with a black belt that cinches at the waist.
